## Walkthrough

This PR improves test robustness by centralizing timeout handling for job completion assertions. It adds a new `ExpectJobToBeCompletedWithTimeout` helper function and applies appropriate longer timeouts across three e2e test files to prevent flaky cleanup and resource verification during Kubernetes object deletion.

## Changes

**E2E Test Timeout Improvements**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Timeout-aware job completion helper** <br> `test/util/util.go` | `ExpectJobToBeCompletedWithTimeout` accepts an explicit timeout parameter to wait for job completion; `ExpectJobToBeCompleted` is refactored to delegate to this new helper with `MediumTimeout`. |
| **E2E test timeout adjustments** <br> `test/e2e/multikueue/baseline/e2e_test.go`, `test/e2e/multikueue/baseline/tas_test.go`, `test/e2e/sequential/baseline/quota_check_strategy_test.go` | Cluster Role Sharing test and TAS topology tests increase workload/job completion timeouts from `MediumTimeout` to `LongTimeout`; quota check strategy test cleanup now uses long timeout for pod deletion and asserts all namespace pods are deleted. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

## Poem

> Where tests once failed, now they're strong,
> With patient waits and cleanup grace,
> No flaky tests shall show their face. 🐰⏳
